outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against the Soprano of Mutopia 1247. The old item was not Greensleeves: its melody (E | A C E | D C B ...) had none of the tune's notes in order. The melody was rewritten from the source in its key (E minor), note for note, with the changes the Beginner caps need, each named in departures: 3/4 for 6/8 with plain rhythms, no raised 6th or 7th, the two turns shortened, one B an octave higher. Still Beginner (index level check passes). The left hand holds one note per bar from the source's bass.
